entries.40fa840cef9db486: Under the new medium-term management plan "S.T.G Vision2026," which started in the fiscal year ended March 2025 with the keywords "“We will expand our business and achieve a niche top position with safety, security, the environment and health” (final fiscal year: the fiscal year ending March 2027)," the company states that it aims to improve corporate value through efforts to address management issues including "human resource development," "overall optimization" and "creation of new businesses." As issues to be addressed, the company lists strengthening its development structure, improving productivity, improving quality, promoting group strategy, securing and developing human resources, and expanding its business through M&A and other means.
